reroll_token.effectText: 下一次商店重抽少花1 Gold。

coupon_stamp.effectText: 下一次Item或Jester購買少花2 Gold。

two_pair_study.effectText: 在商店使用，使Two Pair成長+1。

full_house_study.effectText: 在商店使用，使Full House成長+1。

four_kind_study.effectText: 在商店使用，使Four of a Kind成長+1。

straight_flush_study.effectText: 在商店使用，使Straight Flush成長+1。

line_memory.effectText: Choose a scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

straight_oil.effectText: 下一次Run線確認獲得+40 Chips。

flush_powder.effectText: 下一次同色確認獲得分數 +40%。

pair_splint.effectText: 下一次Two Pair確認獲得+35 Chips。

overlap_pin.effectText: 下一次確認的重疊獎勵上限小幅提高。

emergency_draw.effectText: 如果手牌為空，不消耗牌庫並生成1張隨機牌塊。

score_abacus.effectText: 每個Station第一次確認獲得+30 Chips。

thin_caliper.effectText: 用3張或更少牌確認時獲得分數 +20%。

merchant_stamp.effectText: 進入商店後第一次重抽少花1 Gold。

safety_net.effectText: 每個Station一次，防止第一次會結束run的戰鬥鎖定。

coin_funnel.effectText: 結算時，每次未使用棋盤棄牌給予+1獎勵Gold。

hand_funnel.effectText: 結算時，每次未使用手牌棄牌給予+1獎勵Gold。

echo_bell.effectText: 每個Station第二次確認追加第一次確認分數的10%。

thin_wallet.effectText: 僅在3 Gold以下可用。獲得+5 Gold。

red_swatch.effectText: 下一次確認時，每張紅色牌給予分數 +10%。

blue_swatch.effectText: 下一次確認時，每張藍色牌給予分數 +10%。

black_swatch.effectText: 下一次確認時，每張黑色牌給予分數 +10%。

yellow_swatch.effectText: 下一次確認時，每張黃色牌給予分數 +10%。

rank_chalk.effectText: 下一次確認時，每張同數字牌給予+12 Chips。

deck_needle.effectText: 查看牌庫頂部3張牌並棄掉1張。

tile_polisher.effectText: 每個Station第一張得分牌獲得+20 Chips。

slide_wax.effectText: 下一次棋盤移動也會觸發滑動獎勵效果。

undo_seal.effectText: 撤銷上一次棋盤移動一次。

wide_grip.effectText: 每個Station開始時，最大手牌+1，棋盤棄牌-1。

grand_satchel.effectText: 每個Station開始時，最大手牌+2，手牌棄牌-1。

market_compass.effectText: 進入商店時，Item/Jester候選中較便宜的第一個候選便宜1 Gold。

cross_memory.effectText: 標記1個交叉計分牌。之後該牌作為重疊線計分時，獲得額外牌型成長。

keystone_copy.effectText: Choose any board line. Add its center scoring tile to the top of your deck.

edge_copy.effectText: Choose an endpoint scoring tile from any board line. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

rank_echo.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a random-color tile with the same number to the top of your deck.

color_echo.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a random-number tile with the same color to the top of your deck.

scarce_copy.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

sealed_copy.effectText: Choose a sealed or enhanced scoring tile. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

fate_three_kind_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a three-of-a-kind set using the line's highest number; the other numbers do not overlap.

fate_straight_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the lowest straight set possible from the line's lowest tile, with that tile off-color.

fate_straight_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the highest straight set possible from the line's highest tile, with that tile off-color.

fate_flush_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a flush set using the line's lowest tile color.

fate_flush_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a flush set using the line's highest tile color.

fate_full_house_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a full house with the second-lowest number as triple and highest number as pair.

rank_concord.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a full house with the highest number as triple and next-highest number as pair.

step_rite.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a four-of-a-kind set using the line's lowest number.

color_concord.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a four-of-a-kind set using the line's highest number.

off_color_rite.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the lowest straight-flush set possible from the line's lowest tile.

wild_thread.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the highest straight-flush set possible from the line's highest tile.

number_mask.effectText: Choose a board line. If the line has a 1 tile, use that tile color; otherwise use the highest tile color. Transform it into a same-color 10-11-12-13-1 royal flush set.

flush_house_fate.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a same-color full house using the highest and next-highest numbers.

flush_five_fate.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into five same-color copies of the highest number.

line_pruner.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a three-of-a-kind set using the second-lowest number; the other numbers do not overlap.

trim_color.effectText: 選擇棋盤線內的一個牌塊。移除該線中不同顏色的牌塊，並將等量同色牌塊放到牌堆頂。

trim_rank.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a two-pair set using the highest and next-highest numbers.

deadwood_burn.effectText: 清空一條棋盤線。移除該線的棋盤牌塊並獲得金幣 +3。

sacrifice_line.effectText: 清空一條棋盤線。將該線 2 個牌塊複製到牌堆頂。

cross_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring crossing line. This confirm gives that line score +25%.

corner_rite.effectText: Choose a board line containing a corner. Copy one endpoint tile to your deck.

center_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring line containing the center. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

diagonal_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring diagonal line. This confirm gives that line score +35%.

bridge_rite.effectText: Choose a shared crossing tile. Add a bridge seal; each overlapping scoring line gains Gold +2.

ritual_coupon.effectText: The next item purchase costs 2 less Gold.

ritual_lens.effectText: Reroll current item offers and favor ritual choices.

line_pack_ticket.effectText: Add one extra item offer slot in the next Market.

seal_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.

prune_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.
